title: CSE110: Programming Language I (Java), BRAC University
description: Teaching order for the Java course. Coverage is checked against 'CSE110 Topic Wise Mapping.xlsx'. Every lesson is taught with the loop in AGENTS.md: Orient, Teach (concept cards), Consolidate, Test, Review.

conventions.refs: Printed book pages and section numbers. CR = Complete Reference, HF = Head First, LI = Liang. Read refs/md/INDEX.md and the topic's course cut first.
conventions.core: true = in the CSE110 mapping and examinable. false = extra or optional: teach only after the core lessons of the module, and say it is beyond the course.
conventions.practice: true = integration lesson with no new terms.
conventions.terms: Exact vocabulary the lesson must teach. Used for Phase A (goals) and Test level 1 (terminology).
conventions.analogies: Suggested ONE analogy per concept (AGENTS.md Rule 1). Always give the mapping and where it breaks.
conventions.test: Blueprint for Test levels 2-5. Level 1 comes from 'terms'. Mastery gate: 80% on levels 1-3 and all level-4 programs working.

legacy_id_map.M2_L3: merged into M1_L3 (printing, comments) and M2_L3 (now constants and type conversion)
legacy_id_map.M4_L2: moved to M2_L4 (errors appear as soon as variables do)
legacy_id_map.M5_L2: ternary moved to M3_L3; switch is now optional M5_L3
legacy_id_map.M9_*: arrays are now Module 10 (methods come first)
